title: Add debounced context button
acceptance: One outstanding request, cooldown, cancellation and rate limit. Preserve the consented short-release context request in idle. Hold 3000 ms opens a spoken three-scenario menu once; menu short-release cycles, a new 1000 ms hold confirms, and release barriers prevent double dispatch. No default selection; 15 s inactivity closes. In active mode a new debounced press cancels immediately. Audio/source loss and epoch change cancel without automatic recovery. Follow docs/operations/CROSSING_ASSISTANCE.md.
